check_converged_oszicar: check if a VASP DFT calculation has converged electronically using the OSZICAR output file
count_scf_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
refactor_converged_oszicar: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support a different DFT output format beyond VASP
review_converged_oszicar: review the converged_oszicar function and its electronic convergence logic using NELM and EDIFF thresholds
test_count_scf: test the count_scf function to verify it correctly tallies SCF and ionic steps from OSZICAR files
